outcomes: A new Go library starts from an exported function and a test beside it, and putnami build, putnami test and putnami lint report nothing to fix before the user edits a line
A change to the template or to the framework it uses that breaks this promise fails the template proof, before a user creates a project from it
nonGoals: Packaging the template, its archive contents and the render rules, which tooling/project-scaffolding owns
Adding the created project to go.work, pinning its framework modules and tidying it, which go/project-setup owns
Resolving modules from a proxy: the proof wires a go.work to this repository's framework sources, so a rendered project is proven against the framework it is released with (ADR 0006)

requirements.text: A project rendered from go-library passes go vet and go build without downloading a module.
A project rendered from go-library ships TestHello, and go test runs it to a pass without downloading a module.

A project rendered from go-library passes the linters putnami lint runs: golangci-lint with the Go extension's config/.golangci.yml, then staticcheck, at the versions go/extension/tools/versions.json pins. Neither reports a finding.
